6b05595d: ;
 ;Contains two entry points: EN for returning the index position
 ;of a target string within a search string, and UP for converting
 ;the first letter of a string to uppercase.

7706dc3b: ;
 ;Entry point for DGJHELP.
 ;Queries for a string (X) to locate in another string (Z),
 ;returning the start position or aborting if not found.
53ff3daf: ;Convert first letter of X to uppercase if it's lowercase.

46b376ba: ;Search Z for occurrences of X.
 ;Set % to the position of each match and write it to the terminal.
 ;If no match is found, set % to -1.
e5134c9a: ;If X was not found in Z, set % to -1.

40372d5a: ;If no match, strip first character from X.
 ;Kill search string Z.
